prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render an edge-to-edge desktop web application screen for Agentic Resilience Workbench, with crisp readable English UI and no browser or device frame. The analyst reviews a proposed research program for CCC Intelligent Solutions, can refine it, then explicitly Start research.

The attached screenshot supplies only the incumbent dark Workbench palette, Geist typography, // signature, understated materials, message style and independent floating context card. Exclude its gallery toolbar and its attached question-list composition.

This alternative is DOCUMENT-LED: the research program is one coherent readable proposal artifact within the conversation, instead of a tall questionnaire at the bottom. First the subdued analyst message "Does CCC control the claims workflow, or supply modules an agent could replace?" then an unboxed assistant introduction and a compact document titled "Proposed research program", labelled "Draft · not started". It contains the scope "Photo-led auto physical damage claims" and four concise research questions together:
"1. Who controls coordination?"
"2. What makes switching difficult?"
"3. Could another platform replace CCC?"
"4. Could agents bypass the network?"
Include the short scope sentence "Focus on coordination between insurers, repairers and CCC." This is proposed research, not an analytical answer, no fake support or findings.

At the bottom anchored dock, only a slim attached pending-action strip "Research program ready" with "4 questions", small "+ Add question" and the distinctive "Start research →" launch pill. Below it ONE compact composer "Ask for a change to the program…" with icon-only send. Do not duplicate the document in this dock.

The app header shows // Workbench, company CCCS, context control, and "Illustrative · no research executed". Keep the upper-right floating context OPEN with Plan "Photo-led claims coordination", "Proposed · 4 questions", Outputs "No outputs yet", Sources "Investor day 2025 deck".
